title: MCA extends AOC-4 and MGT-7 for FY 2025-26
detail: AOC-4 and variants can be filed up to 31 Dec 2026, and MGT-7 / MGT-7A up to 31 Jan 2027, without additional fees. AGM deadline is not extended.

title: Small company limits raised
detail: Paid-up capital up to ₹10 cr and turnover up to ₹100 cr, which moves more private companies to MGT-7A.
reference: Companies (Specification of Definitions Details) Amendment Rules, per compliance matrix
